purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Morelia’s official municipal Geoportal describes municipal official cartography and interactive territorial services. Its public GeoServer WFS advertises `gcm:Predio`; schema identifies `clave_catastro` and polygon `geom`. Exact WUP point query returned no features; a bounded nearby WGS84 box returned 487 matched and 3 complete parcels at the requested COUNT=3. These three complete native-CRS polygons are evidence of nearby public geometry only.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official H. Ayuntamiento portal links to the city Geoportal and municipal map services.
Official municipal June 2026 release describes Geoportal Morelia as an interactive cartographic viewer and current territorial-information platform.
Official Morelia Geoportal shell returned HTTP 200; it links the city GeoServer endpoint.
HTTP 200 WFS 2.0 capabilities advertise `gcm:Predio`, title “Predios Catastro”, default CRS EPSG:6369.
HTTP 200 schema exposes `clave_catastro` and polygon-capable `geom`; only those two properties were requested.
HTTP 200 exact-point query returned zero; a nearby 0.004° box query returned 487 matched, with three full polygons requested and retained.
